title: Determining End-of-life Attitudes in patients with Life-limiting disease
summary: In palliative care, both a strong will to live and a desire for death can occur. These can also be very close together. A desire for death can manifest itself in patients wishing for a quick death in the face of severe symptoms. This study aims to determine the frequency of this form of death wish and identify factors that inhibit or promote this desire. 200 patients receiving palliative care will be asked to complete a questionnaire about their experiences. The results may help to improve the care provided to patients in palliative care.
conditions: patients currently receiving spezicaliced palliative care

interventions.name: Adult patients who are receiving specialized inpatient palliative care at Dresden University Hospital, are not imminently dying (medical prognosis >3 days), and are cognitively and linguistically capable of participating in the study are eligible to participate.
